name: hermes-browser-runtime
description: Standalone Hermes browser runtime: drives a real, locally-installed Chromium via puppeteer-core (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to perform real Instagram lead discovery on behalf of one Business Badhao organization's own dedicated, manually-authenticated Instagram account. By default, Business Badhao runs this itself on demand in its own Vercel Sandbox (see src/lib/instagram-discovery/sandbox-runtime.ts) — no operator-run machine required. Can still be run yourself on a separate always-available machine (Docker/systemd, see README.md) if you'd rather not use the Sandbox runtime. Never a cloud browser service, never Playwright, never TinyFish.
